package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

// scenario for query_path_and_body_merge_performed_in_handler: Handlers that merge several request sources inline instead of normalizing inputs before service calls.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UpdateTaskRequest struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Priority    string `json:"priority"`
}

func UpdateTaskHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	taskID, _ := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])

	var req UpdateTaskRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	status := r.URL.Query().Get("status")
	if status != "" {
		req.Priority = status
	}

	merged := map[string]interface{}{
		"id":          taskID,
		"title":       req.Title,
		"description": req.Description,
		"priority":    req.Priority,
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(merged)
}
